findings.detail: Criticality 7/10. This test checks classify_leader directly, but no test verifies reconciliation's decision to clear or retain a live group. The nested-supervisor tests eventually assert an empty pending list, so incorrectly clearing a live survivor would satisfy them. Changing reconcile's comparison from == "reused" to != "reused" could therefore escape coverage while allowing finish() to accept surviving or unknown work.
findings.fix: Add reconciliation tests with recorded allocations and controlled process observations. Assert that survivors, changed-command identities and unreadable identities remain pending and make finish() fail, while confirmed absence and reused identities clear without sending signals.
findings.title: Uncited: Identity tests do not cover reconciliation's fail-closed decisions.
